description: This file defines the implementation of the AAudioServiceStreamShared class, which manages shared audio streams in the Android AAudio framework. It includes methods for buffer capacity calculation, stream opening, timestamp handling, and data writing, indicating it is a core source file for audio stream management.

classes.name: AAudioServiceStreamShared
classes.description: A class managing shared audio streams, including buffer management, timestamping, and stream configuration within the Android AAudio framework.

methods.name: dumpHeader
methods.description: Returns a string header for stream dump information.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string with current stream status and data queue info.

methods.name: calculateBufferCapacity
methods.description: Calculates the buffer capacity in frames based on requested size and constraints.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens and initializes the shared audio stream with specified configuration.

methods.name: getAudioDataDescription_l
methods.description: Provides a description of the audio data queue for the stream.

methods.name: markTransferTime
methods.description: Records the timestamp of data transfer completion.

methods.name: getFreeRunningPosition_l
methods.description: Retrieves the current position and timestamp of the audio stream.

methods.name: getHardwareTimestamp_l
methods.description: Gets the hardware timestamp from the audio endpoint.

methods.name: writeDataIfRoom
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer if there is space, updating timestamps and handling XRuns.
